note: The World Inequality Database (WID.world, bulk download of 15 October 2026, read again in that of 30 October 2026), Kuwait, 2024: average net personal wealth (ahweal992j) and average post-tax national income (adiinc992j) per adult over 20, resources split equally within couples, in KWD of that year, for the bottom 20, 40, 60, 90 and 99 percent and the top 1 percent; each family's band is read from them. Read 2026-10-30. Read again 2026-11-03 from the bulk download of 30 October 2026 (its country files dated 30 October 2026): every row quoted here, its year and its currency label stood as before, and no later year was given. Until 2026-11-03 this note and its sources wrote the variable codes with their age and population parts swapped (ahwealj992 for ahweal992j and adiincj992 for adiinc992j), codes no file of the database holds (its README: type, concept, age group, population, as in sptinc992j), and called adiinc992j post-tax disposable income, which its metadata names post-tax national income ([Post-tax national income]=[Post-tax disposable income]+[Public spending]). The national accounts (the owner's ruling of 2026-11-03: each band's income scaled by households' disposable income over national income), read 2026-11-03: the latest households' account published for this country was in UNdata's National Accounts Official Country Data (the United Nations Statistics Division's), Table 4.6 and Table 4.1, series 100, SNA 1993, for 2017: the net disposable income (B.6n) of households (S.14), 19,304,597,788 less 39,511,739 (19,265,086,049), over net national income (B.5n) 42,306,433,687 less 3,201,646,518 (39,104,787,169), in the table's currency (Kuwaiti dinar), about 0.493. A ratio stands only from 2019 on (the lead's ruling of 2026-11-03), so it wasn't held, and each band's income stayed the database's post-tax national income, public spending included. The national accounts (the owner's ruling of 2026-11-03: each band's income scaled by households' disposable income over national income), searched again on 2026-11-03 in the statistics office's own accounts for a households' disposable income account from 2019 on, found none: Central Statistical Bureau, https://www.csb.gov.kw/Pages/Statistics?ID=25&ParentCatID=3 (National Accounts Statistics), read 2026-11-03: the latest edition listed is 'الحسابات القومية ( 2015-2017 )'; the 2014 edition is the one by institutional sectors. The 2017 figure is already in this note. Nothing for 2019 on. CSB, ID=55 (revised and preliminary estimates, current prices), read 2026-11-03: latest 2009-2011. CSB, ID=80, 'تقديرات الناتج المحلي الإجمالي بالأسعار الجارية و الثابتة (السلاسل الزمنية) الربعية - الربع الأول 2026' (xlsx, downloaded), read 2026-11-03: GDP by activity only. No household income and no GNI. Each band's income stayed the database's post-tax national income, public spending included.
